summary: Retest of iteration_111 action items. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (the existing 13 plus 4 new in test_iter112_bulkcat_retest.py). FIX A PASS: on page 2, typing 'Test' jumps to 'Page 1 of 1 · 48 of 48', the ticked selection and map bar are cleared, and clearing the search goes back to 'Page 1 of 2 · 250 of 303'. Picking a vendor filter on page 2 gives 'Page 1 of 2 · 250 of 265' and clears the ticks. FIX B PASS: the vendor pager has prev/1/2/next and no 'Load more'. Page 1 has 250 rows and page 2 has 15, with no overlap and a union of 265. Opening Backup and tapping the in-app back keeps 'Page 2 of 2' and re-fetches offset=250. FIX C PASS: no /products request uses limit=240 (home uses limit=500). Manual block products render on the shopper home (grid, slider and spotlight). FIX D FAIL for the user (logic works but the user never sees it): the blockedIds filter runs, but only on the hidden in-screen category grid of shop-home (it showed 131 = 133 minus the 2 block products). Both entry points a shopper actually uses (a home strip chip and a More-sheet category) router.push to /shop-category/<name>. That screen has no block filter and lists 'Test Widget' and 'Vendor One Widget', which are both in the 'All picks' product_grid block (General shows 133 items). Search still finds both products (2 results) and a block card opens /product/<id>. FIX E PASS: bulk-category writes subcategory and sub_category together, the public /products filter returns the product on its new shelf and no longer on its old sub-shelf, and an unknown category returns 400 'No such category'. FIX F PARTIAL: the Map-to-shelf sheet no longer shows Recharge sub-shelves or operators, but the Recharge ROOT is still offered as a target. exclude_recharge deliberately keeps the root for Shop Layout. The backend also accepts category='Recharge' (and even 'Vi' as a top-level category). FIX G PASS: mapping shows a 'Products shelved\n\n1 product moved to Books.' dialog on web. Regression PASS: the publish-all confirm opens and cancels, tapping a product with nothing selected opens the editor, /admin/shop-layout loads, and the shopper More sheet shows Recharge with no operators. No deprecated Expo packages found.

minor.issue: Category validation matches ANY shop_categories doc by name, including Recharge and its operator sub-shelves. category='Recharge' (subcategory 'Vi') and category='Vi' both return 200, so a physical product can still be shelved under Recharge or under a sub-shelf name used as a root. subcategory is not checked to belong to the category. The value is stored as typed, not with the canonical name's casing.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Recharge' root is still listed as a mapping target (map-cat-Recharge). The code comment says a physical product must never be shelved there. exclude_recharge=true only removes the sub-shelves, by design for Shop Layout.

integration_issues.issue: shop-home filteredProducts hides block ids, but every category tap (home strip home-cat-* and More sheet all-cat-*) router.pushes /shop-category/<name> (shop-home.tsx ~803 and ~1123). That screen (app/(tabs)/shop-category/[name].tsx) never receives or applies the block ids, so block products 401f3c2b ('Test Widget') and 9c6bb05d ('Vendor One Widget') still appear there (General = 133 items). When blocks exist there is no visible plain grid on home, so the exclusion never shows to shoppers. Also, onBlockProductIds only collects block_type 'product_grid'. Manual horizontal_slider and spotlight product_ids are not excluded.

action_items: MEDIUM (FIX D): apply the block-product exclusion in app/(tabs)/shop-category/[name].tsx too, because that is where shoppers land from both the home strip and the More sheet. For example, fetch home /shop-layout manual product ids (shared helper or context) and filter the category grid when its search is empty. Include manual horizontal_slider and spotlight product_ids in onBlockProductIds, not only product_grid.

LOW (FIX F): drop the Recharge root (and any recharge_group/recharge_kind category) from the Map-to-shelf sheet list in admin/products.tsx. Ideally also reject recharge categories in POST /admin/products/bulk-category.
LOW: bulk-category should only accept root categories as `category`, check that `subcategory` is a child of that category, and store the canonical category name.
critical_code_review_comments: shop-category/[name].tsx and shop-layout-renderer.tsx still make one limit=500 request with no paging, so any category or near-me set over 500 products is silently cut off again. shop-home's main list uses fetchAllPages correctly.
admin/products.tsx filter effect: rapid typing can fire overlapping load(0) calls and an older response could land last. There is no request-id guard. Minor.
Vendor pager: if the vendor deletes the last product on the final page, productPageRef stays out of range and shows an empty page. Minor.
Browser history back (not the in-app back) re-mounts /vendor/dashboard and resets both the tab and the page. This is expected on a remount. The in-app router.back keeps page 2.

success_rate.frontend: ~83% (A, B, C, G and regression pass; D fails for the user; F partial)

rca_of_issue: FIX D: the filter was added to shop-home's in-screen activeCategory grid. Since the 2026-06-10 change, category taps navigate to /shop-category/<name> instead of filtering in place, so that grid is hidden behind the pushed screen. It still renders with 131 items, but the user sees the 133-item category screen. Repro: shopper home with blocks, then More, then a category containing a block product. The block product is listed. Fix: share the block-id set with the category screen and filter there.
